findings.passage: The bill, which included voter ID laws and funding for election audits, was the necessary step to restore trust with the public.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name on the governor's veto of House Bill 1300. He describes the bill's voter ID laws and audit funding as needed to restore public trust.

findings.passage: In order for the public to regain trust in the election system, changes were needed.
findings.note: Beaver County Radio quotes a release from him after the House passed an election bill that, per the outlet, would mandate voter IDs. Same article quotes him on all 67 counties operating the same way for election integrity.

findings.passage: We are ready to get to work on these measurers and want the people of Pennsylvania to be able to vote directly on these proposals.
findings.note: As policy committee chair he hosted a hearing on a package of constitutional amendments that included requiring voters to present identification when casting a ballot. This quote is about letting voters decide the proposals, not about ID itself; the release's ID text is by the caucus, not quoted from him.
